title: Vegetable Cutlets

ingredients.title: For the Vegetable Mixture
items: Green peas – ½ cup, boiled and lightly mashed
Green beans – ½ cup, finely chopped and boiled (optional)
Fresh coriander leaves – ¼ cup, finely chopped

ingredients.title: For Binding & Coating
items: Bread crumbs – ¼ cup, for mixing
Water – as needed to make a thin coating batter

ingredients.title: For Frying
items: Vegetable or mustard oil – as needed for shallow frying

instruction.title: Prepare the Vegetable Mixture
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onion, green chili, and ginger-garlic paste; sauté until the onions turn translucent.
Add grated carrots, green peas, beans, and corn kernels.
Cook for 3–4 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Add red chili powder, garam masala, black pepper powder, and salt.
Mix well and cook briefly to combine the spices.
Remove from heat and let the mixture cool slightly.

instruction.title: Combine and Shape
steps: In a large bowl, combine the sautéed vegetable mixture with mashed potatoes.
Add chopped coriander leaves and ¼ cup bread crumbs.
Mix thoroughly and adjust salt or spices to taste.
Knead or mix until the mixture forms a dough-like consistency.
If the mixture feels too wet or soft, add more bread crumbs as needed.
Divide into small portions and shape each portion into a flat, round patty.

instruction.title: Prepare the Coating
steps: Mix all-purpose flour or cornflour with enough water to make a smooth, thin batter.
Dip each cutlet into the flour batter, coating it evenly.
Transfer immediately to the bread crumbs and coat all sides evenly.
Repeat with the remaining cutlets.

instruction.title: Fry the Cutlets
steps: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Place the coated cutlets in the hot oil without overcrowding the pan.
Shallow fry for about 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and crisp.
Turn carefully and fry the other side evenly.
Remove and drain on paper towels.

instruction.title: Serve
steps: Serve the vegetable cutlets hot with green chutney, tamarind chutney, or ketchup.
Garnish with lemon wedges and fresh coriander leaves.

chefTips: Moisture control: Cook the vegetables until excess moisture evaporates so the cutlets hold their shape.
Binding: Add extra bread crumbs gradually if the mixture feels too soft or sticky.
Coating: Coat the cutlets evenly with bread crumbs for a crisp exterior.
Frying: Maintain medium heat so the cutlets become golden and crisp without browning too quickly.
Make-ahead: Shape and coat the cutlets in advance, refrigerate, and fry just before serving.
